# County sales cleaner

A daily CSV feed is mapped to reporting regions. Rows without a region are retained separately for operations review.

turns.prompt: Repository: county-sales-cleaner. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. In the daily preparation pipeline, which function separates rows with no county-to-region mapping into the quarantine list? Return the function name.
